replies.text: If I may as someone living in Sarajevo, Bosnia. We have had a turbulent history but the irony is, all nations, Bosniaks, Serbs and Croats are incredibly hospitable and nice to foreigners, but not to each other. It's a great curse we have. We all speak the same language and look the same, just with a different religion. We basically have no homeless people, no one dies from starvation here because we all look out for each other. Really really low crime. Sarajevo has a few murders each year, mostly between criminals. Compare that to other capitals. We have amazing nature, and we always have something to do. Hiking, diving, swimming, climbing, biking or simply camping and drinking beer. I am out in nature all the time and I will never in my lifetime see all Bosnia has to offer. I wouldn't trade the feeling of going after work to top of Trebević and look at Sarajevo, for all the riches in the world.
